kind: AUTHOR ERRATUM (errata-not-edits) to pinned, author-written, unreviewed packets. No pinned file is modified.
found_by: owner self-audit (full re-read of v43 statements) before any external use; no reviewer involved.
defect: Preview delay was treated as harmless for LOWER-BOUND constructions. With preview delay delta > 0 the plant receives w(t - delta), so the plant input at time t is only F_{t-delta}-measurable. This does not affect identities or upper bounds (they hold for every plant input adapted to F_t), nor the deterministic robust gain G_rob (shift-invariant over all paths), nor any strictness conclusion. But adversary constructions that need the plant input at time t to depend on W up to time t - the co-rotating input of v39 item 6 / v40 item 6 and the instantaneous input feedback lambda Re X of v43 - are available only for delta = 0. For delta > 0 they become lagged (rotation increments W_t - W_{t-delta} unknown to the adversary) and the claimed lower bounds are NOT established.
severity_self_assessed: MAJOR for the affected equality/exactness statements at delta > 0; every delta = 0 statement, every upper bound, every G_rob statement and every strictness statement is unaffected.

errata.location: section 0, sentence 'Below, the shift by delta is suppressed: it is an isometric relabelling of input times and changes nothing.'
errata.correction: The shift is harmless for item 1 (the identity holds with the plant input w(. - delta), which is adapted) and for items 2-5 (upper bounds and strictness). It is NOT harmless for item 6: the co-rotating input needs delta = 0. Item 6 (EQUALITY G1 = G2 = G_rob for bi-isotropic data) is RESTRICTED to delta = 0; for delta > 0 it is OPEN (only G2 <= G1 <= G_rob = sqrt(m kappa)/|mu| holds).

errata.location: Theorem RS item 6 (EQUALITY, co-rotation) under the class setting 'preview delta >= 0'
errata.correction: RESTRICTED to delta = 0. Items 1-5 and Lemma IS unaffected.

errata.location: Theorem EX 'For every preview delta >= 0, G2^2 = c^2 c_*(c_* x + ((a-b)/2) y)' and the dependent statements of Theorem ST
errata.correction: The UPPER bound G2^2 <= c^2 c_*(c_* x + ((a-b)/2) y) holds for every delta >= 0. EQUALITY (the exact value) is established only for delta = 0, because the lower-bound strategy w = 1_[0,eps] + lambda Re X uses the plant state at the current time. Theorem ST's strictness conclusions hold for every delta (they use only the upper bound and the delta-independent robust bound). The exceptional-locus statement 'G2 EQUALS the rotating-path value' is restricted to delta = 0; for delta > 0 on that locus only G2 <= that value is established.

errata.location: Theorem EQ 'At every preview delta >= 0: EQUALITY ... IF AND ONLY IF y > 2x and x/y = r/(1+r)', Corollary EQ1 and section 4 'Even the literal level is then known exactly'
errata.correction: Theorem RG (exact G_rob) holds for every delta. The EQUALITY direction of Theorem EQ, Corollary EQ1 and the exact-literal-level remark are RESTRICTED to delta = 0. The STRICT direction (G2 < G1 off the locus) holds for every delta >= 0. For delta > 0 ON the locus the verdict is OPEN.

errata.location: Theorem SF1 'For every preview:' items 2 and 3 and the section 3 'Meaning' paragraph
errata.correction: Item 1 (exact G_rob) and item 4 (certificate) hold for every delta. Item 2's exact value and item 3's EQUALITY direction and the 'Meaning' equality-locus sentence are RESTRICTED to delta = 0; item 2 remains an upper bound and item 3's strictness off the locus remains valid for every delta.
